title: Sparse matvec layout + prefetch
description:
Cache-bound sparse kernels. Target the LDPC parity-check matvec path where memory access patterns dominate.

## Children (2 tasks)

- **D1** — `SparseBitMatrix::matvec` CSR (`crates/gf2-core/src/sparse.rs::matvec`). PPC steps: V6 prefetch (look-ahead on `col_idx` array) → V7 layout: try block-CSR with 4×64 blocks → V3 SIMD only inside dense blocks. Gain bar ≥1.5× on the `sparse.rs` bench.
- **D2** — `SparseBitMatrix` row reorder for cache. V7 layout-only: bandwidth minimization (Cuthill-McKee) before dispatch. One-shot pre-processing; amortises across many matvecs.

## Depends on

S0 (all four I-tasks).

## Success criteria

Per-task: per-kernel execution protocol from epic spec doc. Cache-bound steps may rely on cache-miss-rate improvement instead of IPC delta — the asm artefact must show the prefetch instructions actually emitted.
